title: Created limits and colimits for invertible endofunctor algebras
statement: Let $A$ be a category and $T:A\to A$. Let $U$ forget invertible $T$-algebras [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Then $U$ reflects isomorphisms. For any fixed diagram universes, if $A$ has all limits of that size and $T$ preserves them, $U$ creates all such limits. Dually, if $A$ has all colimits of that size and $T$ preserves them, $U$ creates all such colimits. Empty diagrams are included.

source.place: Original twisted-site proof step 5, using the already proved algebra universal properties. Agent twisted variant of Tag 00W0 (proposition-sheaves-on-group), motivation only; exact non-SGA reference WANTED.

proof.text: Use the existing Endofunctor.Algebra.forget limits and colimits from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Endofunctor.Algebra. The property IsIsoStr is closed under these limits and colimits when T preserves them, by its isIsoStr_of_isLimit and isIsoStr_of_isColimit. The full-subcategory inclusion therefore creates them by Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.FullSubcategory, createsLimitsOfShapeFullSubcategoryInclusion and its colimit dual. Compose creation with Algebra.forget. Both inclusions and Algebra.forget reflect isomorphisms, so their composite does too. These are direct instance applications, as in the Lean proof.
